limitations: Browser verification used Edge desktop and an emulated 390px mobile viewport, not every browser/device or a full accessibility audit.
Browser automation is a task-local verification harness, not a GitHub Actions browser job; committed offline tests cover static serving and file boundaries.
The API's existing semantic fixed workflow, request limits and provider reliability limits remain unchanged.
A 75-second browser timeout cannot forcibly cancel a submitted model request; saved-result refresh is manual.
Original PDF viewing/ingestion, multiple-report subset selection in the UI, agent mode and public authentication are outside B09.
